name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began in his father's machine shop in Montreal, where he spent countless hours tinkering with engines and learning the intricacies of metalwork. He quickly developed a knack for fabrication, mastering welding, machining, and composite materials. After honing his skills on local racing teams, Jean-Pierre joined Target Racing five years ago, where he's become an indispensable part of the team.

He's known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to quality. Jean-Pierre demands perfection from himself and others, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in vehicle construction. While some find his intensity challenging, his dedication to crafting race-winning components is undeniable. He prides himself on the structural integrity and aerodynamic efficiency of his work.

physical.description: A powerfully built man with calloused hands and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always has a Gauloises cigarette tucked behind his ear, even though he rarely lights it.
Sharpens his welding tools obsessively before each project.
Speaks fluent French when under stress.
